changelog: v1.4.0: Removed personalized code, fixed ClawHub security scan issues. Generalized GitHub notification handling. No behavior changes for users.
summary: Event-driven email monitoring using IMAP IDLE protocol. Replaces polling with instant push notifications via OpenClaw webhooks. Use when setting up email monitoring, replacing hourly email checks, or implementing event-driven email processing. Monitors multiple IMAP accounts, triggers webhooks on new mail, zero tokens while waiting.
